## Objective
- Expand the folklore adventure with original pixel-art creatures, companion-management menus, and larger connected regions while preserving existing features and controls.

## Requirements
- Give every creature unique custom pixel art and a unique, thematically related name.
- Support checking companions, rearranging the party, healing, and upgrades.
- Preserve adventure features and keyboard/mobile controls as the map expands.

## Decisions
- Named the folklore creatures Kantilume, Tuyuli, Bunira, Toyali, Nangala, Ponia, Rayalamp, and Tasikora.
- Added Cloudstep Terrace and Emberreef Cove, expanding the world from three regions to five.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added companion details, party ordering, herb healing, and shell-funded upgrades.
- Added custom pixel-art sprites for the three starters and eight named spirits.
- Expanded region maps, trainers, and location labels to five regions.
- Updated causeway handling in `tileAt()` to connect the actual map traversal; a connectivity audit found all 448 walkable tiles and all five trainers reachable.
- `node --check` passed, and headless Chromium rendered the welcome screen without detected runtime errors.
- Keyboard and d-pad movement passed a browser check; desktop layout showed no action-grid overflow.

- Fix and rerun browser interaction checks: the temporary harness reported party ordering, sprite rendering, and encounter-flow failures, but those checks have apparent harness issues and do not yet establish game defects.
- Exercise healing and upgrades in-browser; only the temporary harness checks have run so far.
- Check responsive mobile layout and touch-swipe movement.

1. Correct the temporary browser-check harness for party ordering, canvas sprite painting, and encounter flow; rerun those interactions.
2. Validate companion management, encounter flow, pixel art, and mobile layout/touch movement in-browser.
3. Review the final working tree and report results.

- `index.html`: Game UI, creature data and pixel art, menus, maps, and gameplay logic.

- Changes are uncommitted; earlier `git status --short` showed `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh` as untracked.
- The latest browser-check output marked party ordering, sprite rendering, and encounter flow as failures; the harness used invalid assumptions (`c.getContext is not a function` among them), so these results need corrected tests before drawing conclusions.
